skill.name: grilling
skill.description: Stress-tests plans and designs through a focused, one-question-at-a-time interview before implementation begins.
skill.summary: Resolve important planning decisions through a structured interview before building.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The skill is a prompt-only workflow that interviews users about plans and designs. No static findings, prompt injection attempts, executable behavior, or harmful intent were found.

content.value_statement: Unresolved decisions can make a plan expensive to change during implementation. This skill interviews you systematically and recommends an answer for each decision.
actual_capabilities: Interviews the user about one planning decision at a time.
Explores available code to answer factual questions before asking the user.
Provides a recommended answer with every question.
Examines dependencies between design decisions in a logical order.
Waits for explicit confirmation before implementation begins.
limitations: Does not implement the plan during the interview.
Depends on the user to make final decisions.
Can inspect only the code and context available in the current session.
Does not replace specialist legal, security, financial, or compliance review.

use_cases.title: Refine a Product Plan
use_cases.description: Identify unclear requirements, constraints, and priorities before development starts.

use_cases.title: Review a Technical Design
use_cases.description: Examine architecture choices and resolve dependencies before implementation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Client Project
use_cases.description: Clarify scope, delivery expectations, and approval points before committing resources.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Simple Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Interview me about this plan one question at a time: [plan]. Recommend an answer for each question.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a short plan needs a basic readiness check.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify Project Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Stress-test these requirements before implementation: [requirements]. Inspect the available code for facts, then ask me one unresolved decision at a time.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when requirements contain assumptions or missing decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Challenge a Technical Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this technical design: [design]. Trace dependencies between decisions, explain your recommendation, and wait for my answer after each question.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before approving an architecture or implementation approach.

prompt_templates.title: Run an Implementation Readiness Interview
prompt_templates.prompt: Conduct a complete readiness interview for [initiative]. Cover scope, users, architecture, data, security, operations, testing, rollout, and success measures.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a detailed review of a complex initiative.

output_examples.input: Interview me about adding team workspaces to our application.
output_examples.output: Recommended answer: define workspace membership before permissions. First question: can one user belong to multiple workspaces?

output_examples.input: Stress-test my plan to migrate background jobs to a new queue.
output_examples.output: Recommended answer: use a staged migration with rollback support. First question: must jobs remain ordered during the migration?

output_examples.input: Review my launch plan for a paid reporting feature.
output_examples.output: Recommended answer: define entitlement rules before billing integration. First question: which subscription tiers should include reporting?

best_practices: Provide the current plan, known constraints, and desired outcome.
Answer each decision directly before moving to the next question.
Confirm the final shared understanding before requesting implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not request implementation before the planning interview is complete.
Do not omit important constraints or settled decisions.
Do not treat recommendations as substitutes for accountable human decisions.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It interviews you about a plan or design and identifies unresolved decisions before implementation.

faq.question: Will it implement my plan?
faq.answer: No. It waits for your confirmation that the plan is understood before any implementation begins.

faq.question: How many questions does it ask at once?
faq.answer: It asks one question at a time and waits for your response.

faq.question: Does it provide recommendations?
faq.answer: Yes. Each question includes a recommended answer for your consideration.

faq.question: Can it inspect my codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use available code to resolve facts instead of asking you for discoverable information.

faq.question: Who makes the final decisions?
faq.answer: You make every final decision. The skill organizes the discussion and recommends options.
